text: Cameron Vale, a vagrant tormented by voices, learns from the ConSec psychologist Dr. Ruth that he is [one of 237 scanners|threat|powers of the mind], people who can read minds and harm bodies with thought. At a company demonstration, the renegade Darryl Revok makes a man's head explode and sets out [to rule over ordinary people|wants|power over others]. Ruth sends Vale to infiltrate Revok's network, a trail that leads to a pharmaceutical factory making [the drug ephemerol|images|food, drink and drugs] and to [ConSec's own secrets|threat|the powerful and their systems].
